assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias.
The procedure is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The appeal must be submitted within ninety days of the notice.
The missing authorization number must be provided with the appeal.
